title: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
description: The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

title: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns following misconduct allegations
description: President Trump has forced out his ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle. She faced allegations of misconduct before and during her tenure at the U.S. Embassy in Athens, which she has denied.

title: Civil rights advocates plan to send thousands of observers to midterm polling places
description: For many election cycles, civil rights groups and political parties have fanned out to monitor polling places, but the charged midterm environment has many organizations stepping up efforts this year.

title: In Kansas, a newly competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
description: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.

title: Former White House ethics lawyer on Kimberly Guilfoyle's alleged ethics violations
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former chief White House ethics lawyer Richard Painter about the ethics allegations facing former U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle, who resigned Tuesday.

title: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign among corruption allegations
description: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece following allegations that she sought payment from a Trump donor in exchange for access to administration officials

title: Why does Pete Hegseth want to livestream an execution?
description: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has proposed livestreaming the execution of a man convicted of the 2009 attack on Fort Hood. Some scholars say the idea is rooted in his religious background.

title: Conservative super-lawyer squares up for his latest Supreme Court argument
description: Paul Clement, a Republican, has racked up dozens of wins at the Supreme Court since his days as George W. Bush's solicitor general. Recently, he's been challenging some Trump administration policies.

title: Bipartisan group of senators call on Trump to rescind Russian diesel deal
description: Six Democratic and six Republican senators wrote a letter calling on President Trump to withdraw from his recent deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

title: A judge blocks the government's tree-clearing spree at a municipal D.C. golf course
description: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.
